hook.name: ERC4626Hook
hook.description: Routes swaps between an ERC4626 vault's underlying asset and its share token entirely off-PoolManager, using vault deposit/redeem/mint/withdraw. Intercepts swaps in beforeSwap, pulls tokens from the payer, sends output to the recipient, and returns ZERO_DELTA to bypass AMM liquidity. Requires hookData encoding (address recipient, address payer).
